title: What’s in store for politics in 2026?
discussion_signal: The event discussion combines data-driven public-opinion research with live audience polling to examine how global shifts and conflict-related political pressures may affect domestic UK safety judgments, identity boundaries, and cohesion.
linked_research_question: How can a distant conflict reorganize domestic safety judgments, identity boundaries, speech restraint, and interfaith cohesion when most people reject a simple partisan side?
limits: The post describes an event and does not expose the polling results in full
Audience polling is not a representative national sample
The discussion does not establish causal effects of the conflict on cohesion
